svg.title: Claude's plan to keep the room at or above 12 degrees, predicted against real
svg.desc: Left: with the 104 model as its tool, Claude chose 13 heater steps. The model predicted the room would stay just above 12; in the real room the mean falls to 12.1 at step 10 and 10.6 at step 20. Right: with the physics-shaped model, Claude chose 16 heater steps. The model predicted a low of 12.4; the real room levels off at 13.2.
svg.text: With the 104 model as its tool
